meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fight, to brawl', paired with 'подраться'.

examples.text: Ты должен драться за свою любовь.
examples.trans: You must fight for your love.

examples.text: Беги, Самсонов! Ты должен драться за свою любовь.
examples.trans: Run, Samsonov! You must fight for your love.

examples.text: Ваня, тебе нельзя драться на улице!
examples.trans: Vanya, you must not fight on the street!

meanings.en: to be ill, to be sick
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'hurts, aches', paired with 'заболеть'.

examples.trans: My mother is ill.
Your son is ill.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'know'.

examples.trans: Do you know his address?

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'лежать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'made numb by lying on'.

related.gloss: to made numb by lying on (prefixed perfective)
not to made numb by lying on (negated infinitive)

examples.trans: I do not know, you slept on it awkwardly.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и отлежать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and made numb by lying on on time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'slept', paired with 'поспать'.

examples.trans: Thank you very much, Vitya.

examples.text: Он трезвый, а тебе надо выспаться.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ещанный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('promised').
